_comment: Raw kB. A route's number covers the chunk plus everything it statically imports. Lower a number when you shrink a route; never raise one. Enforced by scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs in the unit-tests job. Tightened 2026-09-03 after splitting v4PanelC.ts into v4Meta.ts (light: types, V4_META, V4_RESEARCH_DEGREES, V4_INDEX) + v4PanelC.ts (heavy: V4_ONLY_PROGRAMS, V4_PANEL_A_BASIS, V4_PANEL_C rationale/evidence) — only the report page still imports the heavy module, so it alone now owns the ~3.3 MB chunk. Route numbers are achieved-plus-~10%; achieved was index 667, LandingPage 989, V4ReportsPage 997, AssessorPage 961, V4InsightsPage 999 (all kB).
